question: As of August 2020, who among the following was the Chief Economic Adviser to the Finance Ministry of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Krishnamurthy V Subramanian.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishnamurthy Subramanian was the 17th Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India.**
 
• **Arvind Subramanian was the 16th Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India during the time period of 16th October 2014 to 20th June 2018.**
 
• **The Chief Economic Adviser (CEA):**
 
 
• It is a post in the Government of India and is equivalent to the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
 
• The CEA is the** ex-officio cadre** controlling authority of the Indian Economic Service.
 
• The CEA is head of the** Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance.**
 
• **J. J. Anjaria** was the first Chief Economic Adviser to the **Government of India.**
 
 
 
• **V. Anantha Nageswaran took charge as the 18**th Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India **on 28 January 2022.**
 
 
• He is a former executive with Credit Suisse Group AG and Julius Baer Group.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ajit Pai:**

 
 
• He is the chairman of the prestigious Federal Communications Commission (FCC) of the United States as of March 2018.
 
• He was appointed on 23 January 2017.
